dataset_name: Cleaned Voice Telecom Fraud & Vishing Dataset
publisher_provenance: Custom Telephony Telecom Simulation derived from Mozilla Common Voice Urdu Corpus (v27.0) and Edge-TTS Pakistani Scenarios
license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 (Mozilla Common Voice component) / Academic Research Use

audio_format.telephony_filtering: 300Hz-3400Hz 4th-order Butterworth bandpass with carrier noise and pitch perturbation

known_limitations: Fraud samples are generated using neural TTS with realistic telecom channel simulation; real-world acoustic compression and background noise variations may exhibit domain shift.
Short clips (<1.0s) have insufficient temporal length for stable pitch F0 and jitter estimation.
